stopifnot(file.exists("smoother.pck"))
source("smoother.pck") 

# Load NOAA data (use the raw version as in slides)
stopifnot(file.exists("NOAAnew.csv"))
NOAA.new <- read.csv("NOAAnew.csv", header = TRUE)

# Slide mapping: x = temperature rise (col 3), y = rate of billion-dollar disasters (col 2)
x <- as.numeric(NOAA.new[[3]])
y <- as.numeric(NOAA.new[[2]])
stopifnot(length(x) == length(y))
n    <- length(x)
rngx <- diff(range(x, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot(is.finite(rngx), rngx > 0)

## Shared utilities
# PRESS for linear smoothers: yhat = S y, w_ii = diag(S)
press_from_weights <- function(y, yhat, w_diag) {
  adj <- pmax(1 - w_diag, 1e-12)
  sum(((y - yhat) / adj)^2)
}

# Running-bin weights (window length r around ordered x)
bin_weights <- function(x, r) {
  n <- length(x); W <- matrix(0, n, n)
  o <- order(x)
  h <- max(0L, floor(r/2))
  for (k in seq_len(n)) {
    lo <- max(1, k - h); hi <- min(n, k + h)
    idx <- o[lo:hi]
    W[k, idx] <- 1 / length(idx)
  }
  W
}

# Gaussian kernel weights; optional k-NN truncation; numerically safe
gaussian_weights <- function(x, h, k = NULL) {
  n <- length(x); W <- matrix(0, n, n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    d <- abs(x - x[i])
    if (!is.null(k)) {
      k_eff <- max(1L, min(as.integer(round(k)), n))
      cut <- sort(d, partial = k_eff)[k_eff]
      d[d > cut] <- Inf
    }
    w <- exp(-0.5 * (d / h)^2)
    w[is.infinite(w)] <- 0
    sw <- sum(w); if (sw == 0) { w[i] <- 1; sw <- 1 }
    W[i, ] <- w / sw
  }
  W
}

##2) Smoothers with PRESS inside (as taught: "put it in each smoother")
# A) Running-bin mean
bin.mean <- function(x, y, r, press = FALSE) {
  W    <- bin_weights(x, r)
  yhat <- as.vector(W %*% y)
  out  <- list(yhat = yhat, wii = diag(W))
  if (press) out$press <- press_from_weights(y, yhat, out$wii)
  out
}

# B) gaussian mean 
gauss.mean <- function(x, y, h, k = NULL, press = FALSE) {
  W    <- gaussian_weights(x, h, k)
  yhat <- as.vector(W %*% y)
  out  <- list(yhat = yhat, wii = diag(W))
  if (press) out$press <- press_from_weights(y, yhat, out$wii)
  out
}

# C) Local linear gaussian regression
#    (for PRESS we do LOOCV by refitting locally with w_i=0 — simple & class-consistent)
gauss.reg <- function(x, y, h, k = NULL, press = FALSE) {
  n <- length(y)
  # fitted values at training x (local linear around each x_i)
  yhat <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    d <- abs(x - x[i])
    if (!is.null(k)) {
      k_eff <- max(2L, min(as.integer(round(k)), n))
      cut <- sort(d, partial = k_eff)[k_eff]
      d[d > cut] <- Inf
    }
    w <- exp(-0.5 * (d / h)^2)
    X <- cbind(1, x - x[i])         # centered design; intercept is prediction at x_i
    fit <- lm(y ~ X - 1, weights = w)
    yhat[i] <- coef(fit)[1]
  }
  out <- list(yhat = yhat)          # no w_ii closed form here
  
  if (press) {
    loo_err2 <- numeric(n)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      d <- abs(x - x[i])
      if (!is.null(k)) {
        k_eff <- max(2L, min(as.integer(round(k)), n))
        cut <- sort(d, partial = k_eff)[k_eff]
        d[d > cut] <- Inf
      }
      w <- exp(-0.5 * (d / h)^2)
      w[i] <- 0
      keep <- which(is.finite(d) & w > 0)
      if (length(keep) < 2) {
        yhat_i <- mean(y[-i])
      } else {
        X <- cbind(1, x - x[i])
        fit <- lm(y ~ X - 1, weights = w)
        yhat_i <- coef(fit)[1]
      }
      loo_err2[i] <- (y[i] - yhat_i)^2
    }
    out$press <- sum(loo_err2)
  }
  out
}

## 3) PRESS on slide-17 parameters 
# Slide values (from class code):
# bin.mean(..., 6)
# gauss.mean(..., 0.063)
# gauss.reg (..., 0.078)
# gauss.mean(..., 0.063, k=20)
# gauss.reg (..., 0.080, k=17)
slide_press <- list(
  bin_mean_r6           = bin.mean (x, y, r = 6,              press = TRUE)$press,
  gauss_mean_h0063      = gauss.mean(x, y, h = 0.063 * rngx,  press = TRUE)$press,
  gauss_reg_h0078       = gauss.reg (x, y, h = 0.078 * rngx,  press = TRUE)$press,
  gauss_mean_h0063_k20  = gauss.mean(x, y, h = 0.063 * rngx, k = 20, press = TRUE)$press,
  gauss_reg_h0080_k17   = gauss.reg (x, y, h = 0.080 * rngx, k = 17, press = TRUE)$press
)
cat("PRESS at slide parameters:\n"); print(slide_press)

## 4) greedy random search to minimize PRESS 
greedy_random_search <- function(eval_fun, par_init, par_bounds, iters = 200, step = 0.25) {
  best_par <- par_init
  best_val <- do.call(eval_fun, best_par)
  for (t in 1:iters) {
    cand <- best_par
    for (nm in names(par_bounds)) {
      lo <- par_bounds[[nm]][1]; hi <- par_bounds[[nm]][2]
      prop <- cand[[nm]]
      prop <- if (is.numeric(prop) && prop > 0) prop * exp(rnorm(1, 0, step)) else prop + rnorm(1, 0, step)
      cand[[nm]] <- min(max(prop, lo), hi)
    }
    val <- do.call(eval_fun, cand)
    if (val < best_val) { best_val <- val; best_par <- cand }
  }
  list(best_par = best_par, best_press = best_val)
}

# dataware, safe bounds
bounds_gauss_h <- c(0.01 * rngx, 0.40 * rngx)
bounds_bin_r   <- c(3, min(35, n))
bounds_trunc_k <- c(5, max(10, n - 1))

#objective wrappers (return PRESS only)
obj_bin  <- function(r)               bin.mean (x, y, r = r,              press = TRUE)$press
obj_gm   <- function(h)               gauss.mean(x, y, h = h,             press = TRUE)$press
obj_gr   <- function(h)               gauss.reg (x, y, h = h,             press = TRUE)$press
obj_gmtr <- function(h, k)            gauss.mean(x, y, h = h, k = k,      press = TRUE)$press
obj_grtr <- function(h, k)            gauss.reg (x, y, h = h, k = k,      press = TRUE)$press

set.seed(123)

search_bin  <- greedy_random_search(
  eval_fun   = function(r) obj_bin(r),
  par_init   = list(r = 6),
  par_bounds = list(r = bounds_bin_r),
  iters = 200, step = 0.25
)

search_gm   <- greedy_random_search(
  eval_fun   = function(h) obj_gm(h),
  par_init   = list(h = 0.063 * rngx),
  par_bounds = list(h = bounds_gauss_h),
  iters = 200, step = 0.25
)

search_gr   <- greedy_random_search(
  eval_fun   = function(h) obj_gr(h),
  par_init   = list(h = 0.078 * rngx),
  par_bounds = list(h = bounds_gauss_h),
  iters = 200, step = 0.25
)

search_gmtr <- greedy_random_search(
  eval_fun   = function(h, k) obj_gmtr(h, k),
  par_init   = list(h = 0.063 * rngx, k = 20),
  par_bounds = list(h = bounds_gauss_h, k = bounds_trunc_k),
  iters = 250, step = 0.25
)

search_grtr <- greedy_random_search(
  eval_fun   = function(h, k) obj_grtr(h, k),
  par_init   = list(h = 0.080 * rngx, k = 17),
  par_bounds = list(h = bounds_gauss_h, k = bounds_trunc_k),
  iters = 250, step = 0.25
)

cat("\n--- Greedy random search results (min PRESS) ---\n")
print(search_bin)
print(search_gm)
print(search_gr)
print(search_gmtr)
print(search_grtr)
